title: Cranberry-Apple Shrub Recipe
ldInstructionsRaw: Use a muddler or wooden spoon to crush the cranberries. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and let cook for 10 minutes; remove from the heat, cover, and let steep 24 hours at room temperature. Strain through a fine-mesh strainer and bottle for use. Store in refrigerator, and use within two months.
